notes: robots block: heraldsun.com.au (News Corp AU; identical robots.txt on www and apex, HTTP 200) lists ~90 approved ad/SEO/search bots then 'User-agent: * / Allow: /ads.txt / Allow: /app-ads.txt / Disallow: /', so polite_fetch REFUSES (exit 2, robots_disallow) every URL - homepage, /sitemap.xml, /news-sitemap.xml, /archive/{YYYY}/{MM}/{DD}/ - on both hosts; declared sitemaps (/sitemap.xml, /news-sitemap.xml, taxonomy-category-sitemap.xml) are all inside the disallow and the file's NOTICE forbids automated collection without written permission, so no recipe can pass; verified with urllib.robotparser: can_fetch=False for our UA on all five paths.
